messages:
Alex: Heads-up — GCP announced an inter-zone GPU surcharge for eu-west1 H100 pools starting next month. This could shift unit cost ~+8-12% depending on traffic mix. Need a quick margin check and reserved capacity implications.
Maria: Ugh. Do we have the billing export run against current H100 usage? I can pull 30/60/90 day P95s. :frowning: 
Jon: I ran a rough sensitivity last week for a hypothetical +10% GPU price and we lost ~3.5pp margin on Hosted at current prices. Dedicated customers with committed discounts were less affected.
Sam: If the surcharge is inter-zone egress-like, routing policy could knock us harder for cross-zone KV cache misses. We should check our placement policy for eu-west1 zones. Might opt to prefer single-zone pools for latency-sensitive customers.
Alex: Maria — can you share a quick query we can run to estimate delta on per-token cost? Something like per-GPU-hour usage times new surcharge.
Maria: Yep; I'll start with the billing export. Quick SQL I'm going to run:
```
SELECT
  invoice_month,
  sku_description,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost,
  SUM(usage_amount) AS gpu_hours
FROM `redwood-prod.billing.gcp_export`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%H100%'
  AND region = 'europe-west1'
  AND usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
GROUP BY invoice_month, sku_description
ORDER BY invoice_month DESC
```
Then multiply gpu_hours * surcharge_rate to get incremental cost.
Jon: Also factor in the impact on autoscale tails — if surge traffic goes to other regions because eu becomes more expensive, egress + inter-region latency will compound. Could be non-linear.
Sam: For Dedicated contracts: we should model two options — (1) absorb surcharge under margin buffer and renegotiate future commits; (2) pass through as line item to customers with 30d notice. Need legal/CS input for contract language.
Alex: Short-term ask: can we get a 1-pager with ballpark delta for Hosted and Dedicated by EOD? Include: per-token delta, monthly $ delta, top 5 affected customers by region. Maria/Jon take Hosted, Sam take Dedicated.
Maria: On it. I'll run the query and dump per-customer tags. Expect initial numbers in ~2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
billing-bot: Automated note: latest billing export refreshed at 2026-02-21T09:12:03Z — new rows available.
Jon: For Hosted delta, remember to include cache hit improvements: auto-prefix KV caching reduces tokens by ~12% on our top workloads; that softens the per-token margin hit. I'll add that to the calc.
Sam: Ops question — if we shift more workloads to regional pools to avoid inter-zone surcharge, do we have capacity headroom in eu-central? If not, need short-term borrow from Dedicated spare capacity.
Alex: Good point. Ops, can we get current spare capacity per-region (H100 gpu-hours free over next 7 days) and a rough cost to spin up burst in eu-central vs us-central?
Maria: Pulling spare capacity now. Also checking committed discount tiers — some older Dedicated contracts are under higher discount baselines which changes the marginal math.
Jon: Once we have numbers, propose three options for leadership: 1) absorb, 2) reprice/plumb surcharge to customers, 3) accelerate migration to cheaper quantized model variants + batching suggestions in Optimize to recover unit cost.
Sam: I'll prep a short note for Sales & Customer Success about potential messaging if we pass any costs through. Need to be proactive.
Alex: Perfect. Flagging this as high priority. If we find >7% margin erosion on Hosted, we may need emergency pricing review for next-week exec. :exclamation:
Maria: Results incoming. Will post CSV with per-customer impact when ready.
Jon: Friendly reminder to check reserved instance termination windows — some cloud offers reduce penalty if we convert to region-specific reservations. Could be an arbitrage.
Sam: Also ping finance for negotiation leverage with GCP — multi-month commit? They might offer a waiver for inter-zone surcharge if we commit more.
Alex: Thanks team. Keep thread updated — we'll sync 30m after Maria posts numbers. :eyes:
